products.name: Avoma
products.note: Meeting intelligence AI; conversation analytics; coaching; revenue team data

profile_text.body:
Avoma is a software company headquartered in Fremont, California, that describes itself as offering an all-in-one AI platform covering note-taking, scheduling, and coaching. Its site says the platform is designed to help revenue teams automate note-taking, email follow-ups, CRM data entry, meeting scheduling, lead qualification and routing, call scoring, and personalized coaching, with the company claiming users can save four or more hours per week through that automation.

The core product, also called Avoma, is tracked in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and combines meeting intelligence, conversation analytics, coaching tools, and revenue team data features. The site also describes capabilities around pipeline inspection, deal and churn risk alerts, sales methodology tracking, and AI-driven win-loss analysis, positioning the platform primarily at sales and revenue teams looking to improve forecasting and quota attainment.

The held facts show 174 California law exposure records associated with the company, though no specific litigation cases are on file. Avoma has no MCP server presence recorded and no SEC or patent filings noted in the available data.
